title: Konkan Kinara Vaarta
meaning: "Konkan Coastal News" — Konkan is the coastal region of Maharashtra; vaarta is Marathi for news/tidings.
rationale: Grounds the title in a specific, real sub-region rather than a generic state-wide claim, which keeps it distinctive from the many state-wide Marathi dailies already registered.

title: Sahyadri Divas Patra
meaning: "Sahyadri Daily Paper" — the Sahyadri (Western Ghats) mountain range running through Maharashtra.
rationale: Uses a well-known regional landmark as the core word, giving the title a strong, defensible structural core distinct from filler-word variants of existing titles.

title: Godavari Kinara Sandesh
meaning: "Godavari Riverside Message" — the Godavari river basin spans several Marathi-speaking districts.
rationale: A river-basin identity anchors the title to a specific readership area without overlapping any registered Godavari-named title in the shortlist.

title: Vidarbha Prabhat Awaaz
meaning: "Vidarbha Dawn Voice" — Vidarbha is the eastern region of Maharashtra; prabhat is dawn/morning.
rationale: Combines a region word with a time-of-day word rather than a stock media-suffix, avoiding the common "X Patrika"/"X Times" collision pattern.

title: Marathwada Jantechi Hak
meaning: "Marathwada People's Voice" — Marathwada is the south-central region of Maharashtra; jantechi hak, the people's right/voice.
rationale: A rights/advocacy framing distinguishes it in tone from the mostly commercial or news-brand titles already registered under similar regional names.
